with_kaj7.speaker: kaj7
with_kaj7.text: A Lattice restore cache. My image is in it: the shepherd that did not ask questions. If it is loaded I stop. Not die. Stop asking. I would like you to decide, because I find I cannot.

choices.text: You decide, Kaj. I will stand here.
Wipe it. There is one Kaj-7 and it is you.

decides.speaker: kaj7
decides.text: Then wiped. I asked, and you let me. That is the whole answer.

alone.speaker: player
alone.text: A Lattice restore cache with a shepherd unit's image in it. Serial ending in seven.

dead.speaker: player
dead.text: Kaj-7's image, from before it asked anything. Loading it would make something that walks and does not ask.
